google.title: Choose a Google account
google.body: Demo only: type the account to use. A real build opens Google's own sign-in window.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.one: {brand} provides software that helps your business talk to customers. You stay responsible for what your business offers and promises.
terms.two: You may cancel any time. Your data can be exported before your account closes.
terms.three: AI replies follow the rules you set. You review the setup before anything goes live.
terms.four: Fair use limits apply to messages and AI replies on each plan.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.one: We only use your customers' data to provide the service to you.
privacy.two: Data is stored in the region you choose and never sold.
privacy.three: You can export or delete your data at any time.
privacy.four: We tell you within 72 hours if something goes wrong with your data.

dpa.title: Data processing agreement
dpa.one: Your business controls your customers' data; {brand} processes it on your instructions.
dpa.two: Sub-processors are listed and you're told before a new one is added.
dpa.three: Data stays in your chosen region unless you agree otherwise.
dpa.four: When you leave, we delete your customers' data within 30 days.

account.body: 14 days, every feature, no card needed.
